chapters.title: The problem
chapters.objective: Show that plants report water use but nobody sees the pattern.

units.text: Every plant reports its water use, but nobody sees the pattern in time.

chapters.title: The signal
chapters.objective: Show the water-use signal against the plant's own range.

units.text: Northwind Water Monitor raises a water-use signal when a plant leaves its own expected range.

chapters.title: The action
chapters.objective: Show that the outlook lets the team act first.

units.text: A seven-day outlook from the production plan helps the team act first.
